sourceChecks.scope: Fetched and read the PDF directly (8 pages inspected). The document is Hockey Canada's 'Team Canada -- Program of Excellence: Under 17 Technical Curriculum' (c. 2008). The physical PDF pages 7-8 (matching the cited 'PDF pages 7-8') contain 'TEAM TACTICS AND PRINCIPLES THAT GOVERN PLAY' with the four offensive/defensive principles (Pressure, Puck Control/Stall-Contain, Support, Transition) and their definitions, including 'Support - Offensive: offensive players away from the puck must be available as passing options' and 'Transition - Offensive: measured in a team's ability to move quickly from defense to offense when the puck is recovered.' This supports the scenario's general team-support/transition teaching principle, as the source's 'use' field claims. It does not specifically discuss a 'third player' rush-support concept by that name, name specific coordinates, or validate this exact scene's geometry -- the scenario's 'use' field correctly scopes the source to the general principle only and attributes the rest to original synthesis.
